name: AMENDED Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
AMENDED Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 16, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-12-16 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Proposed revisions to the City of Encinitas Annual Leave Policy (P004) for non-represented employees and the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union - Local 221 amending the vacation accrual limits and vacation cash out provisions. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
1) Approve Resolution 2020-109 revising The City of Encinitas Annual Leave Policy (P004); and 2) Approve Resolution 2020-110 amending the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas/San Dieguito Water District and Service Employees International Union – Local 221.
2020-12-16 Item 08B Annual Leave Policy
8C.
Construction Contract Award for the Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk (100-foot segment near Hillcrest Drive) Project (CS18E, CS16C and CS01E). Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with HSCC, Inc. in the amount of $93,412 plus 15 percent contingency ($14,012) to construct the Base Bid and Additive Alternate of the Gardena Road Sidewalk, Via Molena Curb Ramps and Vulcan Avenue Sidewalk Project, for a total project cost not-to-exceed amount of $107,424.
2020-12-16 Item 08C Gardena Sidewalk
8D.
Contract Amendments for As-Needed Civil Engineering Services. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute amendments to the Dokken, Dudek, Latitude 33 Planning and Engineering, Nasland Engineering, Inc., NV5 and STC Traffic, Inc. agreements for as-needed civil engineering services to extend the term, as needed, to complete existing task authorizations (Attachments 1 – 6 of the agenda report).
2020-12-16 Item 08D Contract Amendments for As-Needed Engineering Contracts
8E.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-16 regulating group homes, including sober living homes, operating in the City of Encinitas and adoption of Resolution No. 2020-105 establishing permit fees for Group Home Permits. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2020-16 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Titles 2, 9 and 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans, and the Local Coastal Plan Relating to Group Homes and Sober Living Facilities;” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-105 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Group Home Permit Fee” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2020-12-16 Item 08E Group Home Ordinance Adoption
8F.
THIS ITEM HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE AGENDA BY STAFF - Proposed personnel changes and approval of the City of Encinitas Pay Range Table and Position Titles. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
Adopt Resolution 2020-108 titled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Approving Personnel Changes and the City of Encinitas Pay Range Table and Position Titles" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-12-16 Item 08F Proposed Personnel Changes
8G.
Authorization to upgrade the Library Information Lab’s end-of-life audio-visual equipment and procure equipment for the new conference room in city hall adjacent to Finance and Human Resources and the Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Approve upgrading the Library Information Lab, procuring equipment to display radar and camera information at the Moonlight Beach Marine Safety Center, and procuring equipment for the new conference room in city hall adjacent to Finance and Human Resources as detailed in the Western Audio-Visual Statement of Work; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Western Audio Visual, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1. The cost to upgrade the audio-visual equipment is $77,359 for design, equipment, and installation. The total contract not-to-exceed amount is $427,258.
2020-12-16 Item 08G Western Audio Visual Contract Amendment
8H.
Emergency Declaration for sediment removal from the San Elijo Lagoon. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Public Works Hireish
Authorize emergency sediment removal from the San Elijo Lagoon under the Emergency Declaration.
2020-12-16 Item 08H Emergency Declaration Sediment Abatement
8I.
Amendment 16 to the Agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the renewal of the existing agreement for a suite of Enterprise software for the City and San Dieguito Water District. Contact Person: IT Applications Supervisor VanPelt
Approve Amendment 16, in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, and authorize the City Manager to enter into the amended agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for a 5-year renewal term for Annual Software Maintenance, and with subsequent 1-year renewal terms for an additional five years, for a total 10-year contract cost of $2,480,852.
2020-12-16 Item 08I Tyler Technologies Contract Renewal
8J.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2020-09, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to implement recent changes to State Density Bonus law and incorporate Planning Commission recommendations and a Housing Program to provide an increased density bonus to incentivize the development of additional affordable housing as an alternative to the 50 percent density bonus provided in Assembly Bill 2345. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
1) Adopt Ordinance No. 2020-09 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Chapter 30.16.020(C) (Density Bonus Regulations) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to be Consistent with State Law.” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-112 titled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting a Housing Program to Incentivize The Development of Affordable Housing by Allowing for Density Bonuses up to 41 Percent.” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report)
2020-12-16 Item 08J Density Bonus Ordinance Adoption
8K.
Rail Corridor Cross-Connect Implementation Plan (Cross-Connect), a component of the Coastal Mobility and Livability Study (CMLS) and the Rail Corridor Vision Study (RCVS). Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-104, titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Rail Corridor Cross-Connect Implementation Plan, A Component of the Rail Corridor Vision Study and the Coastal Mobility and Livability Study."
2020-12-16 Item 08K Cross-Connect Implementation Plan
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Environmental Commission Recommendation to Adopt a Resolution Declaring a Climate Emergency. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Adopt Resolution 2020-90, A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Declaring a Climate Emergency.
2020-12-16 Item 10A Climate Emergency Declaration
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Presentation on the Citywide Pavement Survey and Update describing the City's Pavement Management Program, and the current overall network condition. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Receive the oral presentation.
2020-12-16 Item 11A Pavement Management Presentation
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT-THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 13, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
